guardrails.rule: The .aiw/ folder of this repo is the delivery area of the AIW projection, not this project's own state. Nothing that describes aiw-console is read from it, and no emitter of this project writes into it.
Every file under .project/ has an emitter and is regenerated. No file there is written or edited by hand; a file without an emitter does not enter the folder.
No derivable value is persisted at any level of the roadmap tree: the status of an objective and of a phase is derived when reading, never stored.
No consumer compares project_id against a literal or branches behaviour on its value. It serves to group and to route, never to decide.
A run_id never changes — not by status, not on archiving, not on migrating. An emitter that derives it from a mutable source violates the contract.
The contract folder is created ADDITIVELY: everything under .aiw/ stays untouched until the cut of tramo 7, so what works today keeps working while the new folder exists.
The workshop does not run git in any form. Repository history is read only by the history builder through its own read-only commands.
